_doc: How a band fights a dangerous beast (hunt.gd, sim.hunt). Everyone with an attack job on the same beast is one band. For the kinds listed in `kinds`, the band first musters at a rally point rally_dist from the beast, on the side the people come from, and charges together once all of them are within gather_r of it - or after max_wait seconds, or wait_hurt seconds once the beast has struck someone, or at once if the beast comes within engaged_r of the rally point or of anyone in the band, or someone in it is hit. A band smaller than `band` does not wait. In the fight they take places round the beast ring_r from it, spread evenly, so it is struck from every side: each blow does `flank` more for every other fighter within flank_r of the beast (at most flank_max). A fighter below fall_back_below of their health steps back fall_back_dist out of the fight while at least one other keeps it up. act/fall_act/popup/words: the texts (words: what the one who calls the charge shouts).
